editorial.blurb: Tio Luis serves up authentic Mexican fare in a bright, music-filled space with genuinely warm staff and carefully crafted cocktails.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask your server about the lunch specials—they'll walk you through options and the service is notably quick, especially if you're grabbing a midday meal.

topDishes.note: praised for great taste and quick service
creative dish, though portion control of protein varies
